title: Four Solutions to a Trivial Problem - Guy Steele Jr.
summary: Guy Steele presents a small geometric problem and compares four computational approaches: a classic sequential solution and three parallel-friendly ones. Each is illustrated pictorially and with working code, weighing total work against time to solution.
why: HN points to it as a clear lesson that algebraic properties like associativity unlock parallelism, applicable in any language.

quote.text: watch Guy Steele's talks [1][2][3] if you are interested in data parallelism!
